request.description: This endpoint provides a comprehensive summary of all the payables, offering insights into the current state of pending and completed payments. Ideal for clients and financial departments looking for a snapshot view of their payment obligations.

response.name: A payables summary, with current payables numbers

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
